reason: This plugin is primarily a local media player interface for DeepSeek Harness: it scans local audio files, streams them to the browser for playback, and provides controls and a playlist panel in the web chat UI, with an agent tool to start playback by keyword.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 的本地音乐播放器插件，可扫描本地音乐目录，在聊天界面提供播放条与播放面板并支持曲目列表与播放控制。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness local music player plugin that scans local audio files and adds web chat controls with playlist and playback actions.

capabilities: Scans a configurable local music directory for supported audio files
Streams local audio to the browser via HTTP range requests
Injects playback controls and a floating playlist panel into the web UI
Provides a model tool (`music_play`) for agent-triggered local playback
Shows real-time audio spectrum visualization during playback

reasons.code: Host/client split is defined with a bundled dsh plugin entry and separate web client entry, matching a local playback service plus UI injector model.
Plugin reads a local music folder (default `~/Music`), recursively scans files, and serves audio with HTTP Range streaming behavior.
User-facing behavior includes a chat-adjacent playback bar, playlist/selection panel, mode and volume controls, and spectrum display.
README documents a registered `music_play` model tool that enables agent-driven playback requests from conversation context.
